region_weights.source: General Statistics Office of Vietnam, 2019 Population and Housing Census (regional shares, rounded, merged into three regions)
region_weights.note: Partly checked 2026-10-02: Red River Delta 23.4 percent and Central Highlands 6.1 percent of the 2019 population. The other four regions and the three-way grouping are estimates; verify. A company can override this with its own location and migrant mix.

settlement_by_region.source: General Statistics Office of Vietnam, 2019 census (urban population share, rounded)
settlement_by_region.note: National urban share checked 2026-10-02: 34.4 percent (2019 census, 96,208,984 people). The split by region below is an estimate that reproduces that national figure; verify per region.

education_by_age.source: General Statistics Office of Vietnam, Labour Force Survey (highest qualification of the employed, rounded and regrouped)
education_by_age.note: Approximate shares regrouped into six levels; the generator re-normalises them to a department's minimum education.

marital_by_age.source: General Statistics Office of Vietnam, 2019 census (marital status by age and sex, rounded and regrouped)
marital_by_age.note: Anchors checked 2026-10-02 against the 2019 census: 77.5 percent of people aged 15 and over had ever married; 69.2 percent were currently married; mean age at first marriage 27.2 (men) and 23.1 (women); 9.1 percent of women aged 20-24 married before 18. The age-band rows below are still approximations; verify against the census marital-status table.

children_by_age.source: General Statistics Office of Vietnam, 2019 census and Demographic and Health Survey (children ever born, simplified)
children_by_age.note: Approximate means; the generator draws a count around each mean.

hiring_paths.source: Authoring estimate for gameplay (no public statistic); to be tuned with practitioners
hiring_paths.note: A game parameter, not a measurement.

birth_sex_ratio.source: UNFPA Viet Nam / General Statistics Office, 2019 Population and Housing Census: sex ratio at birth 111.5 boys per 100 girls (Red River Delta 115.3, Mekong River Delta 106.9)
birth_sex_ratio.note: Verified 2026-10-02 against UNFPA Viet Nam census summary (male share = 111.5 / 211.5). Regional ratios differ; a per-region split is a later refinement.

spouse_age_gap.source: General Statistics Office of Vietnam, 2019 census (singulate mean age at marriage by sex: men about 27, women about 23; gap simplified)
spouse_age_gap.note: The census gap in mean age at first marriage is 4.1 years (men 27.2, women 23.1), but couples' age gaps are smaller on average, so this game value is lower; verify with a survey of spouse ages.
